title: Diagnostic performance of ultrasound-based artificial intelligence for predicting key molecular markers in breast cancer: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
authors: Fu, Yuxia; Zhou, Jialin; Li, Junfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文是超声影像组学预测乳腺癌分子标志物的系统综述与Meta分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast cancer (BC) diagnosis and treatment rely heavily on molecular markers such as HER2, Ki67, PR, and ER. Currently, these markers are identified by invasive methods. OBJECTIVE: This meta-analysis investigates the diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound-based radiomics as a novel approach to predicting these markers. METHODS: A comprehensive search of PubMed, EMBASE, and Web of Science databases was conducted to identify studies evaluating ultrasound-based radiomics in BC. Inclusion criteria encompassed research on HER2, Ki67, PR, and ER as key molecular markers. Quality assessment using Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies (QUADAS-2) and Radiomics Quality Score (RQS) was performed. The data extraction step was performed systematically. RESULTS: Our meta-analysis quantifies the diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound-based radiomics with a sensitivity and specificity of 0.76 and 0.78 for predicting HER2, 0.80, and 0.76 for Ki67 biomarkers. Studies did not provide sufficient data for quantitative PR and ER prediction analysis. The overall quality of studies based on the RQS tool was moderate. The QUADAS-2 evaluation showed that the studies had an unclear risk of bias regarding the flow and timing domain. CONCLUSION: Our analysis indicated that AI models have a promising accuracy for predicting key molecular biomarkers' status in BC patients. We performed the quantitative analysis for HER2 and Ki67 biomarkers which yielded a moderate to high accuracy. However, studies did not provide adequate data for meta-analysis of ER and PR prediction accuracy of developed models. The overall quality of the studies was acceptable. In future research, studies need to report the results thoroughly. Also, we suggest more prospective studies from different centers.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌（BC）的诊断和治疗在很大程度上依赖于分子标志物，如HER2、Ki67、PR和ER。目前，这些标志物通过侵入性方法进行识别。目的：本荟萃分析探讨基于超声的放射组学作为预测这些标志物的新型方法的诊断准确性。方法：对PubMed、EMBASE和Web of Science数据库进行了全面检索，以识别评估超声放射组学在BC中应用的研究。纳入标准涵盖以HER2、Ki67、PR和ER作为关键分子标志物的研究。使用诊断准确性研究质量评估工具（QUADAS-2）和放射组学质量评分（RQS）进行质量评估。数据提取步骤系统化进行。结果：我们的荟萃分析量化了基于超声的放射组学的诊断准确性，预测HER2的敏感性和特异性分别为0.76和0.78，预测Ki67生物标志物的敏感性和特异性分别为0.80和0.76。研究未提供足够的数据用于PR和ER预测的定量分析。基于RQS工具的总体研究质量为中等。QUADAS-2评估显示，研究在流程和时机领域存在不明确的偏倚风险。结论：我们的分析表明，AI模型在预测BC患者关键分子生物标志物状态方面具有有前景的准确性。我们对HER2和Ki67生物标志物进行了定量分析，结果显示出中等至较高的准确性。然而，研究未提供足够的数据用于所开发模型对ER和PR预测准确性的荟萃分析。研究的总体质量可接受。在未来的研究中，需要全面报告结果。此外，我们建议开展更多来自不同中心的前瞻性研究。
